# testdata

This repository does **not** distribute the vendor firmware. To run the tools/tests locally, place
the official Ground Control firmware here as:

    testdata/gc326.hex

(Download `gc-*.hex` for firmware v3.26 from endorphin.es.) The file is git-ignored. Supported base
canonical image SHA-256:

    e1db4815f8cf2983f832493aa8b2085586cb5ea10446e133774bdfc91bca9f52
